Privacy and safety are non-negotiable in medical and healthcare settings. Our window films provide an effective and HIPAA-supporting solution for enhancing patient confidentiality in waiting rooms, consultation areas, examination rooms, and patient rooms. Frequently Asked Questions

Are privacy films HIPAA compliant?

Our frosted and one-way privacy films prevent unauthorized viewing of patient areas and confidential information displays, directly supporting HIPAA physical safeguard requirements. We provide installation documentation for your compliance records.

Do films affect the healing light environment for patients?

Our films are specifically selected to maximize visible light transmission while blocking UV and excessive heat. Patient rooms retain a bright, natural light quality — we avoid films that create a clinical or dimly-lit appearance.

How long does installation take in an operating facility?

We work section by section during off-peak hours to minimize disruption. A typical medical clinic is completed in 1–3 days; larger facilities are phased over a longer schedule to ensure continuous operation throughout.
